scope: Allocation-failure rollback for repeated MLEADER text-context DXF group 144 column sizes.

implementation.behavior: The parser checks the existing item cap and reserves one additional column-size slot before consuming group 144. If reserve fails, the parse returns false with the context and column-size vector unchanged; successful insertion cannot allocate after the value is read.

control.allocationInjection: MaterialAllocationFailure offset 0 targets the guarded vector reserve.
checks: Open CONTEXT_DATA and select text content.
Injected reserve failure is observed exactly once and leaves the vector empty while the context remains open.
Retry group 144 with 1.25, append a following 2.5 size, and close CONTEXT_DATA successfully.

limits: This covers only the group-144 MLEADER DXF vector append allocation path.
It does not qualify MLEADER physical producer breadth, native annotation semantics, DWG parsing, or complete document conversion.
next: Continue the P6 safety review at a separate reproduced parser allocation or rollback boundary; keep native and whole-document qualification gates open.
